elements.evidence: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in interest in connection with a merger, acquisition

reasons: Locked target was preferred, but the redline completes only the affiliate/contractor and successor-transfer elements; the paid-up perpetual and irrevocable characterisation and the 'terminable only for uncured material breach' limitation on subscription licences were never inserted, so the preferred level is incomplete.

The fallback bargain is fully satisfied: affiliates are covered directly (better than 'on written notice', which benefits us) and assignment to a successor in a merger, acquisition or substantially-all-assets sale is expressly permitted.

Minimality holds on substance: each inserted phrase maps to a required element ('its affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf'; 'successor in interest in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets'). The deterministic word-ratio gate flags expansion, but no surplus concept, new exception, or boilerplate was added and no clause was rewritten wholesale.

Intent preserved: the Client's non-exclusive-use scope, the 'not obligated to utilize' carve-out and the mutual consent structure of section 15 are untouched; the successor carve-out is drafted reciprocally ('the assigning party'), introducing no undefined term or dangling mechanic.

To reach preferred, add a short insertion such as 'The licence is perpetual and irrevocable upon payment of the applicable fees and may be terminated only for material breach that remains uncured after written notice.'
